scope: Generate an ordinary default DXF plot-style graph when no caller plot-style root is registered
trigger: The LibreCAD installed-codec version tests generated LAYER group 390 = F with no object F in AC1015–AC1032. The 2D consumer therefore published dangling references.

authority.title: Autodesk ObjectARX layer setPlotStyleName object-id contract

implementation: For R2000+ when no ACAD_PLOTSTYLENAME root is supplied, plan distinct dictionary and placeholder output identities before HEADER/CLASSES/TABLES. Prefer conventional E/F only when unreserved; otherwise allocate fresh. Add or merge the required class registrations in an attempt-local copy, enforce class budgets, and emit root membership, Normal entry, default pointer, placeholder ownership and default-layer references. Require record-inventory duplicate checking, reject a late root change and source-reference alias onto the synthetic placeholder, and preserve source-bound roots instead of replacing unprojected plot-style entries. R12/R14 behavior is unchanged. Caller registered plot-style roots retain their existing path.
failure_fix: A whole-write allocation injection sweep exposed a pre-existing use-after-free hazard in CLASSES emission: the failure path destroyed the writer before the record scope unwound. The scope now unwinds before destroying the writer.

verification.focused: PASS: dedicated generated-graph CTest covers six versions, ASCII/Binary, each E/F reservation combination, same-facade repeat, class merging/conflict, source-alias collision, late root and placeholder collision, bounded inventory and refusal/retry, plus R12/R14 controls. Related dictionary-default, dwg2dxf adapter and layer-allocation controls pass 4/4.
verification.allocation: PASS: whole-file allocation sweep and generated graph tests 2/2 in 36.16 seconds after failure-path repair; caller and destination rollback/retry were exercised.
verification.independent: ezdxf 1.4.5 read all 48 locally generated ASCII/Binary version/reservation outputs and verified root dictionary, Normal/default target, placeholder type and owner, and layer target. Outputs are scratch-only.
verification.consumer: LibreCAD macOS ARM64 candidate 6c0a9e0 rebuilt against a clean installed ABI-3 shared codec. DYLD_PRINT_LIBRARIES confirms the new library path; SHA-256 17465558aff27e84f1b68e9fef0c6aada421bd74d6cd0c3aa18cb4576ed73a28. Its [filter][version] selector improved from 1/5 passing with 9 failed assertions to 3/5 passing with 2 failed assertions; the six missing-F assertions and another dangling-reference assertion pass. Two unrelated export refusals remain. The R13 guard controls pass 204 assertions.

limits: This proves the generated ordinary graph only, not native plotting or broad source/profile support. A caller-supplied ACAD_PLOTSTYLENAME graph follows the existing route; default layer F fallback in that route and full membership/semantic validation remain open. Explicit nondefault layer references retain their prior source-resolver contract except collision with the generated placeholder is refused. The inventory introduces per-record memory overhead when synthesis is active. New private dxfRW fields change its layout; ABI-3 consumers must rebuild. No external fixtures or generated DWG/DXF files were committed. P4–P8 phase gates and P9 external claim restrictions remain unchanged.
